items.title: Buddy Burns Interview, 1958-08-14
items.q: I'll pick Nene way back there. He was a wonderful drummer.

ctx.x: I think you heard when you were a kid even if you can remember.

Well, I think I would pick, I'll pick Nene out of all of them. I'll pick Nene way back there. He was a wonderful drummer. Yeah, he was a good drummer. Yeah, for jazz. Very good. Had the right beat. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. You really could swing, you know, with them hitting the drums.
What about clarinet players? Who were the best in those days?
